name: screen_ocr reads text from a real, visible Notepad window
description: LIVE-only companion to 05-ocr-fixture.json: launches a real Notepad window, forces it to a known fixed rectangle via UI Automation's TransformPattern (Move/Resize — no window-manager assumptions), types a marker phrase into it with text_type, then OCRs ONLY that exact rectangle (screen_ocr's `region` arg) rather than the full screen. Only runs under `--live` (npm run eval:live) so the default fast suite doesn't depend on desktop state/focus. IMPORTANT (privacy/safety): this deliberately never does a full-screen OCR capture — a full-screen live capture can pick up unrelated windows and any sensitive content they contain. Always scope live screen_ocr calls to a specific, known region. NOTE: window move/resize uses `Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient,UIAutomationTypes` (assembly load only) rather than an inline `Add-Type -TypeDefinition` C# class — the latter was found to silently no-op (exit 0, empty stdout/stderr) when piped through shell_run's stdin `-Command -` invocation; see shell.js's runPowershell(). Keep shell_run steps here to simple one-liners without inline C# type definitions.

args.command: Get-Process notepad -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process notepad; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1200; Write-Output 'launched'

Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient,UIAutomationTypes; $root = [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::RootElement; $children = $root.FindAll([System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Children, [System.Windows.Automation.Condition]::TrueCondition); $target = $null; foreach ($w in $children) { if ($w.Current.Name -and $w.Current.Name.ToLower().Contains('notepad')) { $target = $w; break } }; if (-not $target) { Write-Output 'notfound'; exit 1 }; $tp = $target.GetCurrentPattern([System.Windows.Automation.TransformPattern]::Pattern); $tp.Move(100,100); $tp.Resize(800,500); Write-Output 'moved'
